title: Travel Agency Conversation

script.speaker: A
script.text: I'd like to book a holiday to Thailand for two weeks.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Wonderful choice! When are you thinking of travelling?

script.speaker: A
script.text: In March. The weather should be good then.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Exactly. March is perfect — dry season. Are you travelling alone?

script.speaker: A
script.text: With my partner. We'd like a mix of beach and culture.

script.speaker: B
script.text: I suggest Bangkok for three days, then Chiang Mai, then Koh Samui for the beach.

script.speaker: A
script.text: That sounds perfect. What's the approximate cost?

script.speaker: B
script.text: For two people, flights and four-star hotels, around three thousand dollars.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Does that include tours and activities?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Not included. I'd budget another five hundred for tours and food.

script.speaker: A
script.text: OK. Can we get travel insurance through you?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yes, comprehensive insurance is one hundred and fifty dollars per person.

questions.stemText: Where does the man want to travel?
When does he want to go?
What type of hotel does the package include?
The man is travelling with his ___.
Bangkok is recommended for ___ days.
The package costs around ___ thousand dollars.
Travel insurance costs one hundred and ___ dollars per person.
Match city to activity.
Match cost to item.
Why is March recommended for Thailand?

fullScript:
A: I'd like to book a holiday to Thailand for two weeks.
B: Wonderful choice! When are you thinking of travelling?
A: In March. The weather should be good then.
B: Exactly. March is perfect — dry season. Are you travelling alone?
A: With my partner. We'd like a mix of beach and culture.
B: I suggest Bangkok for three days, then Chiang Mai, then Koh Samui for the beach.
A: That sounds perfect. What's the approximate cost?
B: For two people, flights and four-star hotels, around three thousand dollars.
A: Does that include tours and activities?
B: Not included. I'd budget another five hundred for tours and food.
A: OK. Can we get travel insurance through you?
B: Yes, comprehensive insurance is one hundred and fifty dollars per person.

title: Reporting a Lost Item

script.speaker: A
script.text: Excuse me, I think I left my bag on the train.

script.speaker: B
script.text: I'm sorry to hear that. When did you travel?

script.speaker: A
script.text: About an hour ago. The ten fifteen from Central Station.

script.speaker: B
script.text: And where were you sitting?

script.speaker: A
script.text: In carriage four, near the window. Seat twenty-two.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Can you describe the bag?

script.speaker: A
script.text: It's a black leather backpack. There's a red keyring on the zip.

script.speaker: B
script.text: What was inside it?

script.speaker: A
script.text: My laptop, my wallet, and some important documents.

script.speaker: B
script.text: I'll contact the lost and found. Please fill in this form.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Thank you. How long will it take to hear back?

script.speaker: B
script.text: We'll call you within twenty-four hours if it's found.

questions.stemText: Where did the man lose his bag?
Which carriage was he in?

fullScript:
A: Excuse me, I think I left my bag on the train.
B: I'm sorry to hear that. When did you travel?
A: About an hour ago. The ten fifteen from Central Station.
B: And where were you sitting?
A: In carriage four, near the window. Seat twenty-two.
B: Can you describe the bag?
A: It's a black leather backpack. There's a red keyring on the zip.
B: What was inside it?
A: My laptop, my wallet, and some important documents.
B: I'll contact the lost and found. Please fill in this form.
A: Thank you. How long will it take to hear back?
B: We'll call you within twenty-four hours if it's found.

title: Discussing a Movie

script.speaker: A
script.text: Did you see the new superhero film last night?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yes! I went with my flatmate. What did you think?

script.speaker: A
script.text: I loved it. The special effects were incredible.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Agreed. But I thought the story was a bit slow in the middle.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Really? I didn't notice. The acting was excellent though.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yes, the main actor was brilliant. It's his best film in years.

script.speaker: A
script.text: How long was it?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Two hours forty minutes. Quite long but worth it.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Would you recommend it to others?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Definitely. I'd give it eight out of ten.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Me too. I'm going to see it again next weekend!

How long is the film?

fullScript:
A: Did you see the new superhero film last night?
B: Yes! I went with my flatmate. What did you think?
A: I loved it. The special effects were incredible.
B: Agreed. But I thought the story was a bit slow in the middle.
A: Really? I didn't notice. The acting was excellent though.
B: Yes, the main actor was brilliant. It's his best film in years.
A: How long was it?
B: Two hours forty minutes. Quite long but worth it.
A: Would you recommend it to others?
B: Definitely. I'd give it eight out of ten.
A: Me too. I'm going to see it again next weekend!

title: At the Gym

script.speaker: A
script.text: Hi, I'm interested in joining the gym. Can you tell me about membership?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Of course! We have monthly and annual memberships.

script.speaker: A
script.text: What's the monthly cost?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Standard is forty dollars. Premium with classes is sixty.

script.speaker: A
script.text: What classes do you offer?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yoga, spinning, and boxing. There are twenty classes per week.

script.speaker: A
script.text: What are the opening hours?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Six AM to ten PM on weekdays. Eight to eight on weekends.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Is there parking?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yes, free parking for members. And we have a pool and sauna too.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Wonderful. I'll take the premium membership, please.

fullScript:
A: Hi, I'm interested in joining the gym. Can you tell me about membership?
B: Of course! We have monthly and annual memberships.
A: What's the monthly cost?
B: Standard is forty dollars. Premium with classes is sixty.
A: What classes do you offer?
B: Yoga, spinning, and boxing. There are twenty classes per week.
A: What are the opening hours?
B: Six AM to ten PM on weekdays. Eight to eight on weekends.
A: Is there parking?
B: Yes, free parking for members. And we have a pool and sauna too.
A: Wonderful. I'll take the premium membership, please.

title: Cooking a Recipe

script.speaker: A
script.text: I want to make spaghetti bolognese tonight. Do you know how?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yes! It's easy. First, fry onions and garlic in olive oil for five minutes.

script.speaker: A
script.text: OK. What next?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Add five hundred grams of minced beef and cook until brown.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Then what?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Pour in a tin of tomatoes and a glass of red wine. Add salt, pepper, and herbs.

script.speaker: A
script.text: How long does the sauce cook?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Simmer for thirty minutes on low heat. Meanwhile, boil the pasta.

script.speaker: A
script.text: How much pasta do I need for two people?

script.speaker: B
script.text: About two hundred grams. Cook it for ten minutes.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Should I add anything on top?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Grated parmesan cheese. It's delicious!

questions.stemText: What dish is the man making?
How long should the sauce simmer?
What is added on top of the dish?
Fry onions and garlic for ___ minutes.
Add ___ grams of minced beef.
Cook pasta for ___ minutes.
Use ___ grams of pasta for two people.
Match each cooking step with the ingredient.
Match cooking time to action.
What liquid is added to the sauce?

fullScript:
A: I want to make spaghetti bolognese tonight. Do you know how?
B: Yes! It's easy. First, fry onions and garlic in olive oil for five minutes.
A: OK. What next?
B: Add five hundred grams of minced beef and cook until brown.
A: Then what?
B: Pour in a tin of tomatoes and a glass of red wine. Add salt, pepper, and herbs.
A: How long does the sauce cook?
B: Simmer for thirty minutes on low heat. Meanwhile, boil the pasta.
A: How much pasta do I need for two people?
B: About two hundred grams. Cook it for ten minutes.
A: Should I add anything on top?
B: Grated parmesan cheese. It's delicious!

title: Planning a School Project

script.speaker: A
script.text: We need to plan our group project for science class.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Right. The topic is renewable energy. Who does what?

script.speaker: A
script.text: I can do the research on solar power.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Great. I'll cover wind and water energy.

script.speaker: A
script.text: We need a presentation too. Can you make the slides?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Sure. And you can write the introduction and conclusion.

script.speaker: A
script.text: When is the deadline?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Friday. We have three days. We should meet tomorrow to check progress.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Good idea. How about after school at four o'clock?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Perfect. My house or the library?

script.speaker: A
script.text: The library is better. It's quieter for studying.

fullScript:
A: We need to plan our group project for science class.
B: Right. The topic is renewable energy. Who does what?
A: I can do the research on solar power.
B: Great. I'll cover wind and water energy.
A: We need a presentation too. Can you make the slides?
B: Sure. And you can write the introduction and conclusion.
A: When is the deadline?
B: Friday. We have three days. We should meet tomorrow to check progress.
A: Good idea. How about after school at four o'clock?
B: Perfect. My house or the library?
A: The library is better. It's quieter for studying.

title: Visiting a Museum

script.speaker: A
script.text: Welcome to the City Museum. Can I help you?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yes, please. Two adult tickets and one child ticket.

script.speaker: A
script.text: That's twelve dollars for adults and five for children. Total is twenty-nine.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Do you have audio guides?

script.speaker: A
script.text: Yes, three dollars each. Available in ten languages.

script.speaker: B
script.text: We'll take two in English please. What are the main exhibits?

script.speaker: A
script.text: Ancient history on floor one, modern art on floor two, and natural science on floor three.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Is there a café in the museum?

script.speaker: A
script.text: Yes, on the ground floor near the exit. Open until five.

script.speaker: B
script.text: What time does the museum close?

script.speaker: A
script.text: Six o'clock. Last entry is at five thirty.

fullScript:
A: Welcome to the City Museum. Can I help you?
B: Yes, please. Two adult tickets and one child ticket.
A: That's twelve dollars for adults and five for children. Total is twenty-nine.
B: Do you have audio guides?
A: Yes, three dollars each. Available in ten languages.
B: We'll take two in English please. What are the main exhibits?
A: Ancient history on floor one, modern art on floor two, and natural science on floor three.
B: Is there a café in the museum?
A: Yes, on the ground floor near the exit. Open until five.
B: What time does the museum close?
A: Six o'clock. Last entry is at five thirty.

title: Changing a Flight

script.speaker: A
script.text: Hello, I need to change my flight booking.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Of course. May I have your booking reference?

script.speaker: A
script.text: It's AB four seven two.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Thank you. And what would you like to change?

script.speaker: A
script.text: I need to fly on the fifteenth instead of the fourteenth.

script.speaker: B
script.text: Let me check availability. There's a flight at eight forty-five and one at three fifteen.

script.speaker: A
script.text: The afternoon one please. Is there a change fee?

script.speaker: B
script.text: There's a fifty dollar change fee plus the difference in fare.

script.speaker: A
script.text: How much more is the afternoon flight?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Thirty dollars more. So total change cost is eighty dollars.

script.speaker: A
script.text: OK. I'll pay by credit card. Can I get an email confirmation?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yes, you'll receive it within fifteen minutes.

fullScript:
A: Hello, I need to change my flight booking.
B: Of course. May I have your booking reference?
A: It's AB four seven two.
B: Thank you. And what would you like to change?
A: I need to fly on the fifteenth instead of the fourteenth.
B: Let me check availability. There's a flight at eight forty-five and one at three fifteen.
A: The afternoon one please. Is there a change fee?
B: There's a fifty dollar change fee plus the difference in fare.
A: How much more is the afternoon flight?
B: Thirty dollars more. So total change cost is eighty dollars.
A: OK. I'll pay by credit card. Can I get an email confirmation?
B: Yes, you'll receive it within fifteen minutes.

title: Community Event

script.text: Did you see the poster about the community fun day?

script.speaker: A
script.text: What time does it start?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Eleven in the morning and it finishes at eight in the evening.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Is it free to enter?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Entry is free but you pay for food and activities.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Will there be things for children?

script.text: Yes! A bouncy castle, face painting, and a magic show at three o'clock.

script.text: Perfect! My kids will love it. Let's all go together.
